correctness.rationale: Exact strict-convexity minimization of the one-dimensional Beckmann potential yields the piecewise Wardrop flow costs. The standard-library exact-rational checker supplies 14,500 assertions but is not treated as a substitute for the analytical proof.

value.rationale: With only mean and variance of future traffic demand observable, infrastructure planners need to know whether adding a road has guaranteed adverse expected total travel time. The sharp threshold yields a distribution-free certification region and exactly delineates where those moments cannot decide the sign, using natural extremal-demand mixtures. The equality law is rigid; this is a structurally motivated applied-network result, not an arbitrary numerical slice or merely a recomputation of fixed-demand Braess behavior.
